# Bundled third-party files

| File | Source | License |
|---|---|---|
| `tailwind-play-3.4.16.js` | Tailwind CSS v3.4.16 Play script, `https://cdn.tailwindcss.com/3.4.16` | MIT, © Tailwind Labs, Inc. |

Bundled so the app works offline and the page makes no third-party requests. Only its layout utilities are used; all colours and components come from `../css/tokens.css` and `../css/components.css`.
